requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so the energy class must be A1, A2, A3, A4, B, or C. The area (850 sqm minimum), capacity (60 people), office use, and Turin location are not energy requirements and are not filtered here.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided. The energy class C requirement and the Turin location are not reference columns here and are left to other agents.
A university student residence needs schools and universities within easy reach. The 75th percentile of the education column is 75.14, rounded to 75.
